title: Source
description: A real thing a person works from: a file, document, recording, page, or other owned material. Records who it belongs to, exactly which version it is, what may be done to it, and how to get back to the original.

schemaVersion.description: Version of this record's schema (semver: major.minor.patch).

id.description: Stable identifier for this source. Never reused for different material.

kind.description: What kind of material this is, e.g. 'pdf', 'image', 'audio', 'note', 'web-page'.

origin.description: Where this material came from (an app, a scan, a share, a device).

owner.description: The person or party who owns this material.

custodian.description: Who currently holds the bytes (a device, an app, a host), if different from the owner.

contentDigest.description: Cryptographic digest of the exact bytes of this revision, as 'sha256:<hex>'.

revision.description: Identifier of this exact version of the content. Changes whenever the bytes change.

structureLocator.description: How to address positions inside this material, e.g. a page map or outline reference.

rightsRef.description: Id of the RightsRecord that governs this material, if one exists.

privacyClass.description: How widely this material may be seen: only its owner, chosen people, or anyone.

mutationAuthority.description: Who is allowed to change the original bytes, if anyone.

encryptionState.description: Whether the stored bytes are encrypted at rest.

storageState.description: Where and how the bytes are currently stored, e.g. 'on-device', 'sidecar', 'exported'.

lifecycleState.description: Where this material is in its life: in use, kept aside, queued for removal, or removed.

originalRoute.description: How to reach the untouched original of this material.

exportRoute.description: How the person can take this material out of the system in a usable form.

recoveryRoute.description: How this material can be recovered independently if the app or device is lost.
